text: Hannes Fink, born on 6 October 1989, is an Italian former footballer who spent his entire career with Südtirol. Playing as a midfielder, he began his professional journey with the Italian fourth division club Südtirol, where his performances attracted interest from teams in the Italian second division, contributing to the club's promotion to the third division. Over the course of fifteen years, Fink remained with Südtirol, retiring at the end of the 2021–22 Serie C season after the team secured its first-ever promotion to Serie B.
